_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd space_engineers/default/egg-space-engineers.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail edits the XML config files with the file parser, one element per line (Octail has no xml parser; upstream's edits would be skipped), and adds the space-engineers tag, automatic Steam and Remote API ports instead of fixed defaults, the no_console_input flag (Wine reads no commands), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, refuses < > & in the name and description (they are written into XML), stops with Ctrl+C handed to the server by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1, which ignores it otherwise; upstream's ^^C was a kill) and ends the container with the server, downloads the starting world and config from the pinned commit instead of the old parkervcp/eggs path (failed downloads fail the install),, makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server, strips the empty first line of upstream's SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg in the install and before every start (with it the server can't read the XML and falls back to defaults: port 27016, Remote API on 8080, no LoadWorld, so "Premade world not found"), and replaces upstream's shared Remote API key with a random one. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Space Engineers
author: eggs@goover.dev
description: Space Engineers is a voxel-based sandbox game set in space and on planets.
startup: sed -i '/./,$!d' config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg 2>/dev/null; export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree=n,b;mshtml=n,b"; wine /home/container/DedicatedServer64/SpaceEngineersDedicated.exe -path Z:\\home\\container\\config -console -ignorelastsession & SE_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${SE_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${SE_PID}" INT TERM; wait ${SE_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installation Script
#
## Define variables
## Octail: the world and config templates from the pinned pelican-eggs commit (upstream's parkervcp/eggs path is gone)
dlurl="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/space_engineers/default"

# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/DedicatedServer64/SpaceEngineersDedicated.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Space Engineers dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Create world and config
mkdir -p $HOME/config/Saves
if [ ! -d $HOME/config/Saves/World ]
then
    curl -fsSL $dlurl/World.zip -o $HOME/World.zip || { echo "Downloading the starting world failed."; exit 1; }
    unzip -o $HOME/World.zip -d $HOME/config/Saves/
fi
if [ ! -f $HOME/config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg ]; then
    curl -fsSL $dlurl/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg -o $HOME/config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg || { echo "Downloading the server config failed."; exit 1; }
fi

rm -fR $HOME/World.zip

## Octail: upstream's config starts with an empty line before <?xml ?>, which makes it unreadable: the server
## then runs on its defaults (port 27016, Remote API on 8080, no LoadWorld: "Premade world not found").
## Drop leading blank lines (this also repairs a config from an earlier install).
sed -i '/./,$!d' $HOME/config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg
## Octail: every upstream config ships the same Remote API key; give this server its own
if grep -q '<RemoteSecurityKey>jrVRQIvlBI8OSsuzwZNzVw==</RemoteSecurityKey>' $HOME/config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg; then
    sed -i "s|<RemoteSecurityKey>.*</RemoteSecurityKey>|<RemoteSecurityKey>$(head -c 16 /dev/urandom | base64)</RemoteSecurityKey>|" $HOME/config/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg
fi

# copy libs for mod support
cp -v $HOME/steamclient.dll ../DedicatedServer64/
cp -v $HOME/steamclient64.dll ../DedicatedServer64/
cp -v $HOME/tier0_s.dll ../DedicatedServer64/
cp -v $HOME/tier0_s64.dll ../DedicatedServer64/
cp -v $HOME/vstdlib_s.dll ../DedicatedServer64/
cp -v $HOME/vstdlib_s64.dll ../DedicatedServer64/

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: APP ID
variables.description: The ID corresponding to the game to download.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name of the server, appears in the Steam browser (no < > or &).
variables.default_value: A Pterodactyl hosted Space Engineer Server

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name of your world (and of your save folder)  !!!!! DO NOT EDIT OR SERVER WILL NOT START !!!!!

variables.name: Server Description
variables.default_value: A Pterodactyl hosted Space Engineer Server

variables.name: Auto Save Interval
variables.description: Time between auto saves specified in minutes

variables.name: Steam Port
variables.description: Steam port (UDP), written to SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Remote API Port
variables.description: Remote API port (TCP), written to SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg. Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: Enable Experimental Mode
variables.description: Enable Experimental Mode. Must be 'true' when using mods

variables.name: Enable In-Game Scripts
variables.description: Allow players to run In-Game Scripts
